event.title: Block B foundation slab pour - Site Casablanca, 14 Feb 2026

reports.text: Block B slab poured today, all good. About 28 m3 went in, went fine, no problems. Crew did a solid job, we're on schedule.

QC record, Block B, 14 Feb 2026. Concrete received: 26 m3 across 4 trucks from BetonPlus. Slump tested 2 of 4 trucks. Truck 1: 15 cm (OK, spec max 18). Truck 3: 22 cm (FAIL, exceeds spec 18). Truck 3 was poured anyway on site-lead instruction. Trucks 2 and 4 not tested.
Delivery log 14 Feb: Block B, supplier BetonPlus, 4 concrete trucks received and signed for. Delivery complete.
Progress payment to BetonPlus for the Block B pour is pending the approved site report. Please confirm volume and conformity before sign-off.

simulated_followup.label: SIMULATED: site lead uploads disposition record
simulated_followup.text: Disposition record, Block B, 14 Feb 2026. The out-of-spec Truck 3 load (slump 22 cm) was rejected on site and returned to BetonPlus; it was NOT placed in the Block B slab. The slab was cast from 3 conforming trucks, approx 21 m3.
